This procedure details the testing procedures and 
 calibration I1, which recommended to be carried out every year as indicated by 
 Y1 in the title block.

The DTM 7033, three-phase percentage biased differential 
 relay. Provides a particularly satisfactory solution for the protection of 
 rotating machines against internal faults and used for differential protection 
 of alternating current machines against phase to phase and phase to ground 
 faults. For an internal fault the relay will close its contacts.
If on external fault therefore the relay will not operate.

The first draft is initiated by Eng. Sherif Ahmed El Beyaliy, 
 tested by Eng. Khalied Diab & Eng. Ehab Abuo El-wafa at 12 June 2008, and 
 accepted by General Manager Eng. Saad Kheder and approved by Eng. Abd El-moatey 
 El-rakaiby Head Sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.

Introduction
This procedure details the testing procedures and 
 calibration I1, which recommended to be carried out every year as indicated by 
 Y1 in the title block.
The DTM 7033, three-phase percentage biased differential 
 relay. Provides a particularly satisfactory solution for the protection of 
 rotating machines against internal faults and used for differential protection 
 of alternating current machines against phase to phase and phase to ground 
 faults. For an internal fault the relay will close its contacts.
If on external fault therefore the relay will not operate.
The first draft is initiated by Eng. Sherif Ahmed El Beyaliy, 
 tested by Eng. Khalied Diab & Eng. Ehab Abuo El-wafa at 12 June 2008, and 
 accepted by General Manager Eng. Saad Kheder and approved by Eng. Abd El-moatey
